vb_textbox.text: I picked the dark purple and brown gnome quite often, and they usually earned me 5-9 mushrooms. HOWEVER, at some stage their number goes down, then you need to pick the other gnome for a few rounds. At least that seemed to work for me. The other ones only sometimes gave large numbers of mushrooms, especially when the purple and brown gnome maybe needed a rest. That's my theory - but towards the latter part of the game, it didn't seem to work as reliable any longer.
